customer_persona: Karan Patel is a practical and organized online shopper inquiring about his smartphone delivery status and exploring warranty guidelines for electronics.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling ShopEase. My name is Amit Patel. Please note that this call is recorded for quality assurance and training purposes. How may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello Amit, my name is Karan Patel. I wanted to check the delivery status of an order I placed, and also ask a general question about your electronics warranty.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Certainly, Mr. Patel. For verification purposes, could you please confirm your ShopEase Order ID along with the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, the Order ID is ORD-73904, and the last four digits of my phone number are 4475.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for confirming that. Just to ensure I have understood correctly, you would like an update on the delivery schedule for your OnePlus Nord CE 3 Lite 5G, and you also have a policy inquiry regarding electronics warranty. Is that correct?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, exactly. I want to make sure I know when the handset will arrive, and my cousin was also looking at certified refurbished electronics on your site, so I wanted to check how warranty works on those.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Under our shipping policy, standard delivery takes 3 to 7 business days from the dispatch date. Your order ORD-73904, valued at Rs 19,999, was dispatched yesterday and is currently in transit. It is on track to arrive by this Thursday within that window.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright, that is good. And what about certified refurbished electronics? What kind of warranty do they have on ShopEase?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Regarding certified refurbished items, our policy is that refurbished products have zero warranty coverage of any kind from ShopEase. They are sold entirely as-is without any warranty period.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, so there is no warranty provided on refurbished gadgets at all?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That is correct, refurbished items carry no warranty coverage whatsoever, whereas brand new units like your OnePlus come with full brand warranty and our return window.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, understood. And for my new OnePlus phone, what is the return window if there happens to be an issue upon delivery?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: As per our returns policy, mobile phones fall under the electronics category, which has a return eligibility window of exactly 7 calendar days from the date of delivery.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fair enough. And in case a return is ever initiated, how long does the refund take?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Approved refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days following pickup and warehouse verification, returned strictly to your original payment method.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is clear. Now regarding the delivery day itself, will the delivery agent require—

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Pardon the interruption, Mr. Patel, but please note that because this is a smartphone order over Rs 2,500, our courier will require a 4-digit Delivery Verification OTP sent to your registered mobile at the time of handover.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that was actually what I was about to ask. Thanks for letting me know in advance.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: To recap our discussion, your OnePlus Nord CE 3 Lite 5G under order ORD-73904 is progressing normally within our standard 3 to 7 business day delivery timeline, expected by Thursday with OTP verification. I have logged this interaction under service request reference SR-44821. Aside from this, is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, Amit, you have answered all my questions clearly. That is all I needed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for contacting ShopEase. We appreciate your business and hope you have a great day ahead!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you, have a good day. Bye.

policy_violations.correct_fact: Certified refurbished electronics carry a 6-month ShopEase warranty.
